nodes.name: Reminders: Tell WhatsLearn It Was Sent

parameters.content:
## Settings (edit once)
Open the node 'My Settings (edit here)' and replace each PASTE_... value. A value set on the n8n server (environment variable) wins over this node. Anything still saying PASTE is treated as not set.

## 1. Incoming WhatsApp learning chat
Meta webhook (GET verify, POST messages). Checks the app-secret signature, answers the challenge, ignores status events, then asks WhatsLearn to handle each message. WhatsLearn does all scoring, unlock and daily-limit checks. OpenAI is used only for grounded tutor answers.

## 2. Mission progress and website sync
Every 2 minutes: claim signed notices from WhatsLearn (mission saved, badge earned) for linked, opted-in learners, send one short message, report back. n8n never calculates points.

## 3. Opt-in lessons and reminders
Hourly: WhatsLearn says who is due (opt-in, chosen time, India time, quiet hours, once a day). Free text only inside the 24 h window, otherwise the approved Meta template. STOP is honoured by WhatsLearn.
